title: How Do Plants Make Oxygen?
description:
The Willow Tree That Was Made of Air
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VbPubYd6Fbs

Leaves only make oxygen in the light. In 1779, Jan Ingenhousz put fresh leaves in jars of water by a sunny window. Tiny silver bubbles rose in the sun and stopped in the shade.

Sources: Jan Ingenhousz, Experiments upon Vegetables (1779).

Pictures: illustrated scenes alongside the spoken experiment. Facts: the 1779 leaf jars and the bubbles that stopped in the shade are Ingenhousz's trial, checked against the source above.

social.hook: Leaves only make oxygen in the light.
social.question: What stopped the bubbles?
social.alt: A green leaf in a water jar, bubbles rising. Hook caption ONLY IN THE LIGHT.
